stories.title: Supply runtime server definitions
stories.text: As an operator, I can provide named MCP servers inline without writing configuration files.

stories.title: Launch through either interface
stories.text: As a workflow author, I can launch driven Norn with the same MCP documents as interactive Norn.

stories.title: Know what is ready
stories.text: As an operator, I can distinguish installed capabilities, verification evidence and remaining work.
